# encapi_node (Data Source)

Looks up the role/environment/params assigned to a Puppet node.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "encapi_node" "web0" {
  certname = "node01.example.com"
}

output "web0_role" {
  value = data.encapi_node.web0.role
}

output "web0_environment" {
  value = data.encapi_node.web0.environment
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `certname` (String) Puppet certname (fqdn).

### Read-Only

- `environment` (String) Assigned environment/status.
- `params` (String) Per-node params as JSON.
- `role` (String) Assigned role.
